name: Silver Surfer: Herald of Galactus
description: Norrin Radd sacrificed his freedom to save his homeworld, becoming the Silver Surfer—herald of Galactus. Now trapped on Earth after defying his master, the Surfer must protect the planet from cosmic threats while seeking redemption.
flavorText: I was his herald. Now I am his enemy.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Wonder / Awe Discovery. Silver Surfer as herald turned protector. Soaring lonely strings and cosmic brass. Melancholic and cosmic, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
